instruction: Search for the most recent open issue in "cli/cli" that matches the keyword "build", then write it in the format "#<number> <title>" to the file "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_search_4_4.txt". If there are no matching issues, the file should be saved empty.
reference_command: gh issue list --repo cli/cli --state open --search 'build sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_search_4_4.txt"
